findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router is active and reachable on port 8891, but call_log_exists is false and call_log_size_mb is null for configured path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure the directory for call_log.jsonl exists with appropriate write permissions and router initialization creates the log file.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into model call metrics, latency, and error tracing.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: observability_gap; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.95; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Changes to running services require verification

findings.title: Direct Gemini API call bypassing model router in emergency alert processing

evidence.observation: Hardcoded call to call_gemini directly accessing GEMINI_API_KEY instead of delegating through model router

proposed_action.description: Route intelligence/emergency alert processing requests through the model router using an appropriate task type.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures centralized fallback handling, latency tracking, rate limiting, and unified cost management.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: router_bypass; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: high; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Router bypasses must be corrected by design review
